description:
Read a text file of the project (res://), a line or byte window of it, or parts of a .json, with the whole file's sha256. Pass that sha256 to summer_write_file or summer_replace_text to change the file safely.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/read-file"}

json_path.description: For a JSON file: return only this value, e.g. 'pieces.wall_a', 'pieces["a b"]', 'items[3].size_m'.

keys.description: For a JSON object (the file root or the json_path value): keep only these keys; * and ? wildcards, e.g. ['wall_*'].

keys_only.description: For a JSON object: return only its key names (after the keys filter), not the values — a cheap table of contents.

limit.description: Return at most this many units (lines by default). The result's window.next_offset continues the read.

max_bytes.description: Most bytes of content to return (UTF-8). Default 200000. A window or JSON selection is cut at this size too.

offset.description: Skip this many units (lines by default, see unit) before returning content. 0 = from the start.

unit.description: What offset/limit count: 'lines' (default) or 'bytes' (cut on UTF-8 character boundaries).

name: summer_read_file
title: Read a project file
